correctness.rationale: For a≠0,1 in characteristic 7 the branch sets of quartic elliptic covers are disjoint, yielding genus 5 Riemann-Hurwitz and prime-to-7 Klein-four isogeny J(Ca)~E1×E2×J(Da) with D:y²=(x⁴-1)(x⁴-a). Both j=1728 elliptic quotients are supersingular in characteristic 7. Direct expansion of F_a(x)^3 over F7[a] gives the Cartier matrix anti-diagonal entries -3a²(a+1), -(a-2)(a+1)(a+3), -3(a+1). The 2-cycle off-diagonal entries vanish simultaneously at a=-1, so stable semilinear ranks are 0 at -1, 2 at 2,4 and 3 otherwise; add elliptic a-number 2 to obtain (7-rank,a-number) (0,5),(2,3),(3,2). For rational a=2,3,4,5,6, exact finite-field character sums for genus-three D at degrees 1,2,3 and genus-3 functional equation determine its full L-polynomial and multiply by U²: U³V-V+ at 2,4, U²V-B at 3, U²V+B at 5, U^5 at 6, with #C6(F49)=120. Independently expanded polynomial coefficients in F7[a] and checked full rank pattern; source finite-field zeta checker inspected and equations replayable but no independent exhaustive F343 execution claimed.
